claims.claim_text: Multiple identical figures in different poses are present in the image.
claims.brief_justification: The same skateboarder in the same clothing appears five times across the frame in successive poses.

claims.claim_text: The presence of multiple identical figures is indicative of image manipulation.
claims.brief_justification: IMAGE B, the source photograph, contains the same five repeated instances of the skater, so the repetition is part of the source sequence image and not the annotated alteration.

notes: Location matches the annotated region and the repeated figures really are visible, but the mechanism claim fails: the same five duplicated figures are already present in the source photograph, so they cannot be the evidence of alteration. The annotated area is a small block around a skateboard nose, so 'significant' alteration is overstated.
